beats.summary: Oscar reveals he is having an affair with Senator Lipton and asks Kevin to keep it a secret.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: I know you saw me with the Senator. I think I'm in love, possibly for the first time. So yes, Senator Lipton and I are having an affair.
Oscar: Kevin, listen to me. I'm in love with the Senator. And I need time to sort this out in a responsible matter so I need your help in keeping it a secret

beats.summary: Andy's family is in crisis due to his father's actions, and Andy is managing the aftermath.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Andy's family had a total meltdown. His dad blew through all their money and took off to Argentina with a younger woman.
Andy: Are the 'Nard's hurting? Yeah, you bet. Got kicked pretty hard. Family shattered, super sad. But, I'm kinda crushing it in the damage control department.

beats.summary: Andy struggles with selling the family boat, which holds sentimental value despite financial need.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Yes the boat means everything to my family, but we need the money. Got the memories, don't need the boat.

beats.summary: Dwight eagerly volunteers to appear on a local radio show to promote Dunder Mifflin.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: The media can make you famous. And do you have any idea how easy it is to sell something when you're famous?

beats.summary: Kevin frequently uses the excuse 'I have to go to the bathroom' to leave situations, which others find amusing.

evidence.snippet: Kevin (running from elevator): I have to go to the bathroom!
Oscar: That actually wasn't the worst cover. I'd say at least once a week, Kevin runs out of the room shouting that he has to go to the bathroom.
